## Marvell CEO Shrugs Off Qualcomm-Amazon Threat, Calls Firm 'The Switzerland of This Entire Market'

The CEO's positioning is a direct counter-narrative to the displacement read implied by the Qualcomm-Amazon deal — whether the market sustains the premium will depend on whether MRVL's hyperscaler customer diversification holds up under scrutiny.

- Marvell's CEO publicly addressed the Qualcomm-Amazon chip deal, characterizing MRVL as a neutral custom-silicon partner rather than a displaced competitor.
- The 'Switzerland' framing positions Marvell as agnostic to which hyperscalers win — an explicit attempt to decouple MRVL from deal-specific competitive risk.
- MRVL stock continued climbing even as the Qualcomm deal created sector noise, suggesting the market partially accepts the neutrality argument.
